title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system that thinks in melodies: a three-dimensional school of pieces where a signal starts a branching cascade, pieces that fire together learn to talk more, and harmony cuts what sounds wrong. A will listens to the melody and answers; starting with no shared language, the two invent one by talking. Everything is deterministic and verified bit for bit across an interpreter, a routine engine and a native translator. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar, un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías. Prototipo de investigación.
